claim: Blood turns every wall whose picnum is the mirror tile 504 into a one-way wall at level start (cstat |= 32, over_picnum = 504) and draws a reflection through it; a wall whose over_picnum is 504 with a stack XWALL type is a room-over-room link and gets the same bit.
use: Use tile 504 on a wall only for a mirror; render_slots applies the transform when it says what a wall draws.
